name: Eye of Chaos
text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. You get +2 [willpower] for this test. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. For each [curse] token revealed during this investigation, you may discover 1 clue at a connecting location or place 1 charge on Eye of Chaos.
text_cn: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]调查。这次检定你+2[willpower]。如果你成功，在此地点发现1个额外的线索。这次调查中每抽出一个[curse]标记，你可以发现1个在连接地点的线索，或在混乱之眼上放置1充能。
